payload.title: Greece Wedding Cost and What It Includes
payload.h1: Greece Wedding Cost and What It Includes
payload.excerpt: What shapes the cost of a wedding in Greece for Australian couples, from island, venue, season and guest travel to what venue packages include, what sits outside them, paying in euro from Australia and the questions to ask before you request a quote.
key_takeaways: The total for a wedding in Greece is set by island, venue type, season, guest numbers and how much guest travel you cover, so ask every venue to quote against the same written brief.

A civil wedding has its own paperwork: as at November 2026, Rhodes asks for documents officially translated into Greek, an Apostille on Australian documents and fees at several steps (general information, not legal advice).
Ask each supplier which currency the quote, deposit and balance are invoiced in, when each payment falls due and what happens to money paid if plans change.

As general information as at November 2026, an overseas business selling directly to Australian consumers must follow the Australian Consumer Law, but a remedy can be difficult to obtain in practice, so read the cancellation terms before you pay.

faq.q: Is it expensive to have a wedding in Greece?
faq.a: It can be either. A town hall ceremony with lunch for close family and a clifftop weekend with ferries for every guest sit at very different ends. Island, venue, season, guest numbers and guest travel decide where yours lands.

faq.q: How much does a wedding in Greece cost?
faq.a: This guide gives no headline figure, because no single number holds until your island, venue, date, guest list, legal route and guest travel are set. For a real one, send each venue the same written brief, then compare the written quotes line by line.

faq.q: What affects the cost of a Santorini or Mykonos wedding?
faq.a: The same drivers apply on every island: venue, exclusive use, date, guests, transfers and accommodation. Compare quotes for each island against one brief.

faq.q: What sits outside a Greek wedding package?
faq.a: Ask about photography, music, hair and make-up, transfers, extra events, official fees, taxes and overtime. Treat anything not written into the package as not included.

faq.q: How much does it cost to marry legally in Greece?
faq.a: As general information as at November 2026, fees apply at several steps, and each body sets its own. In Rhodes, a fee applies at the registry office, the Australian Embassy in Athens charges for notarial services, and DFAT charges to legalise Australian documents. Confirm each with the authority.

faq.q: Can foreigners get married in Greece?
faq.a: Yes. As general information as at November 2026, the Municipality of Rhodes, for example, publishes the documents foreign nationals need for a civil marriage. Smartraveller says an overseas marriage can't be registered in Australia, but it is generally recognised here if it was valid under the law of the country where it took place and would have been valid under Australian law had it taken place in Australia.
